name: Shanghai Action Education Technology CO.,LTD.
summary: Shanghai Action Education Technology CO.,LTD. offers management training services to private entrepreneurs in China. The company provides management education services, including management courses, onboarding guidance, annual consulting, and learning tools, as well as public courses, in-house training, and online courses. It also offers enterprise management consulting and training services, as well as sells related books and audio-visual products. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
